complete-home-softener-filtration-system.alt: Whole Home Water Filtration and Softening System — media tank cutaway showing carbon, softening resin and polishing gravel

aspects.headline: IT RUNS ITSELF.
aspects.body: The smart valve on top of the tank washes and recharges the system on its own — you never have to touch it. Ceramic discs inside last for years, and a 72-hour memory backup means a power outage never erases your settings.

aspects.headline: GOODBYE, CHLORINE.
aspects.body: The city adds chlorine to keep water safe in the pipes — but you don\u2019t want to drink or shower in it. Our carbon is made from real coconut shells and grabs chlorine, chloramine and bad tastes as water passes through. Every faucet in the house gets cleaner, better-tasting water.

aspects.headline: SOFT WATER, EVERY TAP.
aspects.body: Hard water is water full of dissolved rock — calcium and magnesium. That\u2019s what leaves spots on dishes, crusty white buildup on faucets, and dry skin. Millions of tiny resin beads trade those rock minerals out of your water before it reaches your pipes. Softer skin, cleaner dishes, appliances that last years longer.

aspects.headline: BUILT TO SPEC.
aspects.body: Everything is sized for a real household — high flow so showers, laundry and sprinklers can all run at once with zero pressure loss. NSF-certified media, lifetime warranty, and a free reverse osmosis drinking-water system included.

dual-tank-system-for-well-water.alt: Dual Tank Well Water Whole Home Filtration System — softening resin tank and Katalox Light media tank cutaways

aspects.headline: AIR DOES THE WORK.
aspects.body: Well water often carries dissolved iron and sulfur you can\u2019t see — until it stains your sinks orange and makes water smell like rotten eggs. This valve keeps a pocket of pressurized air inside the tank. When water passes through, the air naturally turns those dissolved metals into solid particles the media can catch. No chemicals added, ever.

aspects.headline: ODOR, TRAPPED.
aspects.body: Once the air pocket turns iron and sulfur into solid bits, the Katalox Light media bed traps them like a net — and it even nudges your water\u2019s pH up for better taste. It cleans itself with automatic backwashing, so maintenance stays close to zero.

aspects.headline: SOFT WATER, EVERY TAP.
aspects.body: Well water is usually hard water too. The second tank is packed with USA-made resin beads that pull out the calcium and magnesium — so on top of clear, odor-free water, you get soft water at every faucet and shower.

aspects.headline: BUILT FOR WELL PUMPS.
aspects.body: 30 GPM valve flow built to keep up with well pumps, NSF-certified media, lifetime warranty — and a free reverse osmosis drinking-water system included. Add the Pre-Sediment Filter and UV Purifier for complete well protection.

reverse-osmosis-system.alt: HW800 AlkaPro tankless reverse osmosis system — white unit with black front panel and chrome faucet

aspects.headline: DOWN TO 0.0001 MICRONS.
aspects.body: A human hair is about 70 microns wide. This system filters down to 0.0001 microns — small enough to stop heavy metals, microplastics, PFAS \u201cforever chemicals,\u201d bacteria and viruses. Seven stages of protection between the pipe and your glass.

aspects.headline: THE GOOD MINERALS, BACK IN.
aspects.body: Most RO systems strip everything out — including the minerals that make water taste great. The HW800 AlkaPro adds healthy minerals back in and balances the pH, so your water tastes crisp and helps your hydration.

aspects.headline: TWO WAYS TO GO PURE.
aspects.body: Want maximum output and 70% less under-sink space? Go tankless with the HW800 AlkaPro — 800 gallons a day, filtered on demand. Prefer the proven classic? The traditional tank system stores purified water pressurized and ready to pour instantly. Either way, it\u2019s included free with any whole-home system.

aspects.headline: TWIST. SWAP. DONE.
aspects.body: Filters twist out and twist in — no tools, no technician, no appointment. The auto-flush system even cleans the RO membrane by itself to make every filter last longer. Culligan and Pentair can\u2019t say that.
